participation.context: Spoke the night's path, refused the head, and sent himself to sleep.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You followed the night's figures as far as the solemn one, stopped the laugh when the jaw stopped it, and told yourself to mark it and sleep.

title: Laughed into the shawl, and marked it to sleep

participation.context: Wrote the word and did not make it a part.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set down the single word and did not add a second.

title: Wrote one word on the tables

participation.context: Spoke the two sentences and did not go on.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You named the size of it, set it against a king's exit, and stopped.
